visualCharacteristics: Base: horizontally scrolling slides with a photo background and a dark translucent text box, round prev/next buttons and a dot strip below. Option carousel-hero: full-bleed photo masthead (320px mobile, 400px tablet, 500px desktop) with a centered white title and subtitle overlaid directly on the photo (no text box), bare chevron arrows at the edges, small dots overlaid at the bottom center, and autoplay with a JS-generated PAUSE/PLAY toggle at the bottom right.
contentPattern: One row per slide: an image cell (picture or img) and a text cell (title heading, optional subtitle heading or paragraph, optional links). Arrows, dots and the autoplay toggle are generated by JS and are never authored.
usage: Rotating promotional slides. Use carousel-hero as a page-opening full-bleed masthead with centered overlay text and autoplay.
reuseGuidance: Keep the image cell + text cell per row model. Autoplay runs only with carousel-hero, pauses on hover/focus, honors prefers-reduced-motion, and can be toggled by the user.
